name: d0cgxn-due-launch-gate
goal: Keep scheduled work out of unattended launch until the due time, then launch it through normal dispatch

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Runs 1263 and 1264 started automatically about two hours after schedule-on, ahead of their stored due timestamps.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Tracker due-launch coverage only ticked the scheduler. It now enables the schedule and sweeps idle work before due; dispatcher coverage rechecks queued automatic claims and recovery.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed replay 49c242db33 failed: the watchdog set a launch token and the runner recorded later00001 as automatic before its due time.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The dispatcher reuses the scheduler due-time calculation for unattended admission. The native runner rechecks the stored due time before starting.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Clean snapshot 09c71be8cc passed the same ten tests. The watchdog left the item unqueued, it started as due at the exact time, and automatic claims and recovery respected the gate.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: The unchanged clean red/green replay passed on 09c71be8cc. Integrated candidate c432b4b243 passed 51 Tracker unit and integration cases, one signed hub-spoke CLI case, scoped TypeScript, ESLint and formatting. Shared check requested; the planner could not resolve existing ESLint and desktop script imports and ran no focused assertions.
